_note: Products are Catalan. The year above decides which are on sale when.

products.name: Tortell de Reis
products.subtitle: Marzipan, candied fruit, a figurine and a bean
products.description: Made from Christmas until the sixth of January and not a day longer. Inside there is a small figurine and a dried broad bean: whoever finds the bean pays for the tortell, and whoever finds the figurine wears the crown.

products.name: Tortell de Sant Antoni
products.subtitle: Round, with marzipan

image.alt: A round tortell topped with marzipan and pine nuts

products.description: The seventeenth of January, for the Tres Tombs.

products.name: Coca de llardons
products.subtitle: Pork crackling, sugar and pine nuts

image.alt: A flat coca de llardons, crackling and sugar across the top

products.description: Eaten on Dijous Gras, the last day before Lent. Fatty and salty and sweet all at once.

products.name: Bunyols de Quaresma
products.subtitle: Fried in the morning, rolled in sugar

image.alt: Fried rings rolled in sugar, on a wire rack

products.description: All through Lent. Made in the morning and eaten the same day; by the next day they are not the same thing.

products.name: Crema catalana
products.subtitle: Cinnamon, lemon, burnt sugar

image.alt: The sugar on a terracotta dish being burnt with a torch

products.description: For Sant Josep, the nineteenth of March. Burnt with an iron to order.

products.name: Coca de Sant Jordi
products.subtitle: In the colours of the Catalan flag
products.description: The twenty-third of April. Given with a book and a rose.

products.name: Mona de Pasqua
products.subtitle: Sponge, chocolate, hard-boiled eggs and feathers

image.alt: Ring-shaped mones on a market table, each with a whole egg baked into it

products.description: Given by the godparent to the godchild on Easter Monday. Traditionally it carries as many eggs as the child has years, until the child is grown and then it stops.

products.name: Coca de Sant Joan
products.subtitle: Candied fruit and pine nuts

image.alt: A coca topped with candied fruit and pine nuts

products.description: For the night of the twenty-third of June. We make a great many and they all go.

products.name: Coca llarga
products.subtitle: Olive oil and sugar
products.description: Plain. Oil, sugar, nothing else.

products.name: Panellets
products.subtitle: Marzipan and pine nuts, and coconut and coffee too

image.alt: A tray of panellets — pine nut, coconut, coffee and cherry

products.description: For Tots Sants. Sold by weight; half a kilo is about twenty-five.

products.name: Neules i torró
products.subtitle: Thin neules, torró from Agramunt

image.alt: Bars of almond torró on a board, with almonds beside them

products.description: For Christmas.

products.name: Xuixo
products.subtitle: Fried, sugared, filled with custard

image.alt: A fried xuixo dusted with sugar, on a plate

products.description: From Girona, not Barcelona, but they are made here every morning.

products.name: Ensaïmada
products.subtitle: A spiral, dusted with icing sugar

image.alt: A coiled ensaïmada under icing sugar

products.description: From Mallorca. Made with lard and left to rest overnight.

products.name: Croissant de mantega
products.subtitle: Butter and nothing else

image.alt: A tray of croissants, just out of the oven

products.name: Pa de pagès
products.subtitle: Sourdough, twenty-four hours

image.alt: Round floured loaves cooling on cloth

products.description: Round, thick-crusted. Keeps three days.

products.name: Pa de sègol amb nous
products.subtitle: Rye and walnuts

image.alt: Slices of dark rye studded with walnuts, on a board

products.name: Barra de quart
products.subtitle: The everyday loaf

image.alt: Thin loaves in a paper bag

products.name: Cafè sol
products.subtitle: A single shot, in a small cup

image.alt: A cup of black coffee on a marble counter

products.description: What you order standing at the counter. One euro forty, and nobody hurries you.

products.name: Tallat
products.subtitle: Espresso cut with a little hot milk

image.alt: A tallat in a small glass on a saucer

products.description: A cortado, if you grew up calling it that. The milk is there to take the edge off, not to fill the cup.

products.name: Cafè amb llet
products.subtitle: Coffee and hot milk, a full cup
products.description: The morning one. Most people have it with a croissant and read the paper standing up.

products.name: Xocolata desfeta
products.subtitle: Thick drinking chocolate, spoon included

image.alt: A cup of thick drinking chocolate with a spoon in it, xurros alongside

products.description: Thick enough that the spoon stands in it. Winter, and with xurros if we have them.

products.name: Te
products.subtitle: A pot, with leaves not bags

image.alt: A teapot in low morning light

products.description: Mint, camomile or black. The pot holds two cups and the second is always better.

products.name: Orxata
products.subtitle: Tiger nut milk, cold, from June
products.description: From June until it gets cold again. Made with tiger nuts, served so cold it hurts a little.
